data.name: Infested Marine
data.baseSource: v1.10.26 card photos from r/StarCraftTMG (2026-11-25); may be pre-release

abilities.name: Live for the Swarm!
abilities.text: When this Unit attacks an Enemy Unit with the INFESTATION Status or a Unit Within 6″ of any Source of Creep or Creep Tumor, its Infested C-14 Rifle and all Close Combat Attacks gain PRECISION (2).

abilities.name: Detonation
abilities.text: Immediately before any models in this Unit are Destroyed, Enemy Units Within 2″ suffer HITS 1 (1) for each model in this Unit that will be Destroyed.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (2) 4+ effect.

upgrades.name: Burrow Ambush
upgrades.text: When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10″ of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

upgrades.name: Plagued Munitions
upgrades.text: Immediately after an attack with the Infested C-14 Rifle, if the attacked Unit suffered Damage, it also suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1).

data.note: The card database lists Wild Mutation at 1 mineral and as replacing the Infested C-14 Rifle, though it's a Close Combat weapon. Both look like typos, but the v1.10.26 card photos print “for Infested C-14 Rifle” too, so the app charges 1 and keeps the rifle. Check against the official printed card when it's out.
